definitions.explanation: The ability to move quickly and easily, both physically and in terms of mental or organizational responsiveness.

notes:
⟦{敏捷|びんしょう}→敏捷：21167_binshou⟧ (nimble, agile) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, quality). Used in sports, fitness, and business contexts. In sports science, it refers to the physical capacity for quick directional changes. In business, it describes organizational responsiveness.
